new_public_values.name: buffer-source-with-mutation
new_public_values.signature: forall r. (Nat ->{IO r, Mut r} (ReadEvent, BufferSource r)) -> BufferSource r

conservative_effect_policy: A general source can become mutable on any continuation. General reads and transfers therefore require IO+Mut even when a particular call is currently satisfied by an IO-only source or buffered bytes.
higher_order_impact: Sink.ReaderFrom must accept a read callback with IO+Mut. Merely widening its outer operation would still erase the callback effect.
promotion: Review exact signature cost and both frontend checks before considering promotion; original22-cycle hold remains.
